Richard Phillips, 8:40 a.m. (Phoenix Time)

I had fun chatting last night with Doug and Grant on the Paranexus Universe show …
http://www.blogtalkradio.com/ParaNexus/2009/06/19/Life-on-Other-Planets-It-Does-Exist-with-Richard-Phillips-1

Topics ranged across the interstellar map, pretty much whatever those two entertaining characters could dream up, concluding with my typical admonition to listeners.  “Take nothing for granted.  Question everything.”

Tonight I will be a guest on After Dark Radio  with Anthea Appel at 10:00 PM Eastern Daylight Time.
